what: Recovery gate uses git diff HEAD --stat which ignores untracked files
scenario_or_breakage: A malformed manifest after an implementation that only added new files still emits manifest-schema-invalid and loses the untracked work the recovery path is meant to preserve
suggested_fix: Gate on git status --porcelain or combine git diff --name-only HEAD with git ls-files --others --exclude-standard and add an untracked-only regression test

what: Recovery does not exclude malformed needs_qa manifests with partial edits
scenario_or_breakage: Implementers are allowed to leave partial working-tree edits while asking questions; if that needs_qa manifest is malformed and the tree is non-empty the plan converts it into claude_fallback and commits incomplete work without the required answer
suggested_fix: Only recover prior status complete or absent larch1-style complete fingerprints; if prior status is needs_qa preserve the existing needs_qa repair/bail behavior

what: Recovery exits before existing post-implementer mechanical guards
scenario_or_breakage: A malformed manifest plus a dirty tree can bypass branch unchanged, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, submodule clean, and Cursor HEAD-unchanged checks before granting ORCHESTRATOR_EDIT_AUTHORITY=allowed
suggested_fix: Run the same branch/protected-path/submodule/Cursor-history checks inside the recovery function before emitting claude_fallback, preferably via a shared guard helper, and add recovery tests for each bypass

what: The plan adds RECOVERY_FROM and RECOVERY_PRIOR_TOOL but omits the dispatcher contract doc
scenario_or_breakage: The script stdout grammar remains documented as a fixed key set, so future parser or harness changes can silently drop the recovery markers
suggested_fix: Update step2-implement.md stdout contract, outcomes, and edit-in-sync notes alongside SKILL.md and step2-implement.sh

what: The inline manifest template is only protected by substring checks
scenario_or_breakage: Manual schema duplication in agents/_implementer-base.md can drift from the normative schema while tests still pass if schema_version and the heading remain present
suggested_fix: Add a stronger sync check that extracts the inline JSON/template and required-fields table and compares the field set/status requirements against codex-manifest-schema.md or generate the inline block from the schema reference
